decisions.reason: As a recently launched industrial fitting that was at least mentioned on the website, it is likely kept while the firm gives this niche B2B product more time, though its lower web prominence raises some risk.

A dedicated product page suggests active commercial support, and for a German fabricated-metal firm a standard pipe bracket would usually be retained beyond its first year unless demand is clearly weak.
Because it had its own page and fits closely with the firm's core metal support and piping applications, management would typically continue offering it rather than withdraw it after only one year.
